literal_meaning: চলা এবং ফেরা (walking and moving around)
figurative_meaning_en: behavior; conduct; mannerisms; way of carrying oneself
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চলাফেরা দেখে বোঝা যায় সে সৎ মানুষ।
example_sentences_in_english: From his mannerisms, it's clear he's an honest person.
note: This is a compound word often used idiomatically to describe one's overall demeanor.
